LESSON: MELODY

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS
Strand: Creating and Executing
Topic 1.5: Melody

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Melody
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why is it necessary to apply composition techniques in composing a melody?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. sing the sol-fa syllables d r m f s for pitch discrimination
2. compose short melodies based on the sol-fa syllables d r m f s
3. appreciate melodies created by self and others

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)
